skills.trigger: When evaluating post-operative chest radiographs to assess surgical outcomes, specifically lung re-expansion and mediastinal position relative to a pre-operative baseline.
steps: Compare the opacity and volume of the affected hemithorax between pre- and post-operative images to determine if the lung has re-expanded (transition from whiteout/mass to aerated lung with vascular markings).

Assess the position of midline structures (trachea, heart) in the post-operative image; distinguish between complete resolution (midline return) and partial recovery (persistent shift due to residual volume loss, fibrosis, or diaphragmatic elevation).
